notes:
Stream buttons rewritten to match the desktop app.

Each stream's details now sit one per line - release, codec, audio, size, source, languages - instead of being run together into a single block of text. That was the actual difference: the TV app was merging the lines the addon sent, and the desktop app never did.

Buttons are now sized to the stream they describe, so a short entry is a short button with no empty space, and a detailed one is only as tall as it needs to be.

On a movie, streams now stack one per line from top to bottom, so choosing one is just up and down on the remote.

"All addons" is now selected by default in every addon picker, so a title opens showing every source that answered. Picking a single addon narrows it, and addons stay in the same order as your Addons page.

Fixed: pressing up in a stream or episode list could jump out to the buttons at the top of the page instead of moving up one item.
